name: Shanghai Aiko Solar Energy Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Aiko Solar Energy Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of photovoltaic products in China. It offers solar cells, all back contact modules, and digital products. The company also provides solutions to residential, commercial and industrial, and utility sectors. It serves installers, distributors, and module manufacturers. The company also exports its products to Europe, the Asia Pacific, Japan, Korea, the Middle East, Australia, and Africa. Shanghai Aiko Solar Energy Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is based in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.
